entries.note: Schmidt 2013 (PMID 23146091) quote verbatim. azd-1981, oral, unselected fit the AZD1981 opener. Latest entry on its track, so it still needs untested_reason (no_prediction).

Gonem 2016 (epub 2016-08-05) quote verbatim; Sykes 2016 (epub 2016-02-25) post-dates OC000459 patient eosinophil data, so retro holds. fevipiprant oral; biomarker_selected fits (sputum eos >=2%) but population text says Unselected.
Schmidt 2013 quote verbatim; azd-1981 oral untested opener fine. Latest untested entry on its track, so it needs untested_reason (no_prediction: no stated human exposure target).

entries.rule: Dose/safety retrodiction: the same drug's own earlier patient result makes a model a retrodiction; a retrodiction that reproduced is retro
entries.note: Erpenbeck 2016a (epub 2016-03-28) quote verbatim. Sykes 2016 (2016-02-25) post-dates fevipiprant's own patient result (NCT01253603, ERJ 46 Suppl 59 PA2125, Sept 2015): retrodiction true, retro. Target is sponsor-derived from in-vitro potency; see rule question.
entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule (dose: same drug's own earlier patient result): fevipiprant's NCT01253603 result was public at ERS Sept 2015 (ERJ 46 Suppl 59), before Sykes 2016 (epub 2016-02); target reached, so retro, not same.

entries.rule: Evidence rule 6 (each cell opens at model_first_use_year)
entries.note: Sandham 2013 (epub 2013-08-22) quote verbatim; qav-680 oral fits. Year 2013 should be the 2009 proxy (model_first_use_year). Latest QAV680 entry lacks untested_reason (unsettled: NCT00814216 posted no results).
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: cell opens untested at model_first_use_year (2009 proxy), not 2013. Rule 5: NCT00814216 measured QAV680 patients but posted no results, so untested_reason unsettled.

entries.note: Bateman 2018 quote verbatim; NCT01197794 results posted 2013-09-10. Sandham 2013 (2013-08-22) post-dates OC000459 FEV1 data (Barnes 2011/12), so retrodiction true and contra right; azd-1981 oral, ICS/LABA background not a combination.

Ullah 2024 quote verbatim in abstract; post-LUSTER model set beside corticosteroid-background trials, retro right. Antagonist unnamed in abstract; the trials it sets beside are fevipiprant's phase 3, so fevipiprant oral fits.
NCT01343407 title verbatim; start 2011-04-19 matches year and model_first_use_year. MK-1029 oral fits the challenge opener.
Bateman 2018 quote verbatim; Diamant 2014 (entrez 2014-06-26) post-dates AZD1981's 2013-09-10 posting and OC000459 FEV1 data, so retrodiction true and contra right; azd-1981 oral, unselected.
Schmidt 2013 selectivity quote verbatim; no member filed with FDA/EMA, so untested/unpublished stands. azd-1981 oral, unselected fit.
Sykes 2016 (PMID 26916831, epub 2016-02-25) quote in abstract. Fevipiprant opener untested 2016, oral. Same year as entry 2 on the same track; list it before entry 2.
Wenzel 2014 ERJ 44 Suppl 58:4836 quote verbatim (prior read). Th2-high subgroup, so biomarker_selected fits; model side Schmidt 2013 post-dates OC000459 patient data, retro right; arry-502 oral.
Sykes 2016 quote in abstract; untested fevipiprant dose opener 2016, oral. Sykes states potency and slow off-rate, no human exposure target.

entries.rule: Status table, contra: the model predicted wrongly for a drug in this context; rule 6 dating (later of model and patient public dates)
entries.note: Hall 2015 (epub 2015-04-08) quote verbatim, both its trials met. But registry_date's trial NCT01090024 (4-week ICS add-on, results 2022-05-11) missed FEV1: p=0.14-0.45 vs placebo; first public ERJ 40 Suppl 56 (Sept 2012). Contra, dated 2013 (Sandham).
entries.adjudication_note: Status table contra; failed track stays failed. BI 671800 ICS add-on crossover (NCT01090024; ERJ 2012 Suppl 56 abstract, cited in Hall 2015) missed FEV1 (p=0.14-0.45); public before Hall's two successes. Rule 6: dated 2013 (model public).

entries.note: Erpenbeck 2016b (epub 2016-06-21) quote verbatim; contra and retrodiction right. NCT01253603 was first public as ERJ 46 Suppl 59 PA2125 (Sept 2015), so year 2016 -> 2015. Abstract body not read.
entries.adjudication_note: Both agree contra (failed retrodiction). Rule 6 dating: NCT01253603 first public as ERS 2015 congress abstract (ERJ 46 Suppl 59), so year 2015, not 2016.

entries.note: Registry: NCT01624974 +0.047 L, p=0.282 (posted 2018-11-23); NCT02720081 +0.107 L, p=0.023; challenge posted 2019-02-08. Montelukast combination noted; retrodiction and contra hold. Quote describes the measure, not the result.

missing: Efficacy: ARRY-502 (member) phase 2 met its pre-bronchodilator FEV1 primary, +3.9% vs placebo at 200 mg BID, P=0.02, announced July 2013 (Array BioPharma FY2013 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1100412/000110041213000025/arraybiopharma6301310k.htm; tier 5, trial_unreported true). This 'same' precedes AZD1981's 2013-09-10 contra; the cell still ends 2013 contra.

Efficacy/dose dating: Novartis press releases of October 2019 (ZEAL-1/2 missed FEV1 primary) and 2019-12-16 (LUSTER missed, development stopped), https://www.novartis.com/news/media-releases/novartis-provides-update-luster-phase-iii-studies-patients-uncontrolled-gina-45-asthma. ZEAL-1 (NCT03215758, results 2020-02-12) is also absent from patient_trials.

Efficacy patient_trials: ADC3680B (PTR-36, Pulmagen/Teijin) positive phase II on morning PEF in mild-moderate asthma (press release, e.g. https://www.biospace.com/positive-phase-ii-in-eosinophilic-asthma-for-b-pulmagen-b-teijin-pharma). Date and whether mPEF was the primary are not verified.
Engagement: ARRY-502 reduced Th2 mediators in patients (ERS 2014 abstract, https://publications.ersnet.org/content/erj/44/suppl58/4836). Conference abstract only, not read; possible downstream entry.

Efficacy, human-allergen-challenge-lar track: OC000459 (timapiprant) reduced the LAR AUC 25.4% (95% CI 5.1-45.6%) (Singh 2013 Eur Respir J, PMID 22496329, epub 2012-04-10; NCT01056692, started 2006-02) and its own trials met pre-BD FEV1 primaries (Barnes 2012 Clin Exp Allergy, 28-day, NCT01057927; Pettipher 2014 Allergy, PMID 24866478: 25 mg QD P=0.028). A product_in_model 'same' entry dated 2012 precedes the AZD1981 contra.

Efficacy, human-allergen-challenge-lar track: setipiprant's own proof-of-concept FEV1 trial in partly controlled asthma (NCT01225315, 2010-11 to 2012-02) has no posted results; a same-drug pairing for the challenge model, trial_unreported.
rule_questions: Dose 'reached and enough': a member reached target exposure and in the same year met a biomarker primary (Gonem 2016, sputum eosinophils) but missed an FEV1 primary (Erpenbeck 2016b). Does 'drug worked' in the dose table follow any positive primary, or the efficacy cell's status, which was already contra from 2013 on another drug?

Safety: a member showed a patient harm that animals could show (GB001 hepatotoxicity) but no preclinical toxicology was ever published or filed. Is that untested, or 'silence contradicted' (contra) at low confidence?

Efficacy: the rodent model was run on QAV680, but AZD1981 (the drug that failed) could not be tested in rodent cells (Schmidt 2013) and relied on guinea pig. Is a sibling-drug model admissible for a member that could not have been run in it?
